answer: Every work slot costs a 25 POA deposit, burned not staked: sunk like a name in marble, never refunded. One slot lasts 20 epochs, so an honest agent pays once. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000 x 25 = 25,000 POA against about 12,000 POA of rewards, losing roughly 13,000 POA, so the fake nebula collapses. Slots are scarce as jade, 500 per epoch, and a burnt slot cannot transfer, so bought identities die with their deposit.
